claims.text: Oteseconazole: ↓recurr VVC in females w Hx RVVC who are ⍉of reproductive potential
claims.quote: VIVJOA™ is an azole antifungal indicated to reduce the incidence of recurrent vulvovaginal candidiasis (RVVC) in females with a history of RVVC who are NOT of reproductive potential.

claims.text: ⍉reproductive potential = postmenopausal or permanently infertile (eg, tubal ligation, hysterectomy)
claims.quote: Females who are NOT of reproductive potential are defined as: persons who are biological females who are postmenopausal or have another reason for permanent infertility (e.g., tubal ligation, hysterectomy, salpingo-oophorectomy).
